from scipy import ndimage
def variants(cells):
    res=set(); cur=list(cells)
    for _ in range(4):
        for fl in (cur,[(b,-a) for a,b in cur],[(b,a) for a,b in cur],[(a,-b) for a,b in cur]):
            ys=[p[0] for p in fl]; xs=[p[1] for p in fl]
            y0=min(ys); x0=min(xs)
